entry.title: MX2E-WVGA_TM-WV3.23-20250528
entry.content:
Original Timmkoo Q3 software **MX2E-WVGA_TM-WV3.23-20250528**.
- Model: **Q3** (Timmkoo) - Package: `rom_q3.zip` - Build tag: `MX2E-WVGA_TM-WV3.23-20250528` - Build date: 2025-05-28
## Install
1. Download `rom_q3.zip` (every numbered volume if the release has more than one, then `cat rom_q3.zip.* > rom_q3.zip`). 2. Unzip it. Keep the scatter file next to the images. 3. Open SP Flash Tool, choose **Download Only**, load the scatter file from the archive and flash. 4. Or use Innioasis Updater CE: <https://innioasis.app/guide.html>
This wipes the player. Back up music and recordings first.
